newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber sharply higher, limit up on strong cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber sharply higher, limit up on strong cash.

text.p: CME lumber futures traded sharply higher to up the $10.00 per tbf daily limit early on Thursday in reaction to talk of additional gains in cash lumber prices, traders said.
On Wednesday, Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $394.00 per tbf, but traders said prices have since topped $400.
Trading was active in January before it posted the limit gain. Traders said about 235 contracts traded in the first 15 minutes.
At 0922 CST, lumber was up $10.00 to $3.20 with January up the limit at $419.30.
